name: Crushcog's Arsenal
summary: Crushcog's Arsenal is an entrenched staging area nestled in the snowy hills of Dun Morogh between Ironforge and the gates of Gnomeregan. Dominated by a massive, sealed hangar door, it serves as an open-air munitions yard held by irradiated technicians and salvaged gnomish war machines.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Snow
sections.body: Situated along the frozen ridgelines between Gnomeregan and Ironforge, Crushcog's Arsenal stands before a reinforced, sealed hangar gate built into the rock. The staging ground outside is crawling with leper gnomes—specifically irradiated technicians—toiling over heavy mechanostriders, battle suits, and restored mechano-tanks. It serves as an unsettling reminder that the toxic madness gripping the fall of Gnomeregan continues to spill out into the snowy valleys of Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: It is an outdoor staging post and munitions yard fronting a large, locked hangar in Dun Morogh. Positioned between Ironforge and Gnomeregan, the area is overrun by hostile leper gnomes and dangerous salvaged machinery.
The yard is held by irradiated technicians, armed Crushcog battle suits, and repaired mechano-tanks, all aligned with the crazed leper gnomes pouring from the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Can you get inside the large hangar gate?
faq.answer: No. The massive industrial gate behind the staging area remains firmly locked and sealed, leaving only the exterior yard accessible.

faq.q: Why is this machinery out in the snow?
faq.answer: The leper technicians have assembled and repaired heavy suits and mechano-tanks outside Gnomeregan, using the yard as an assembly ground to project mechanical force across the Dun Morogh mountainsides.

angles.text: Seeing gnomish ingenuity twisted into toxic warmachines right on the doorstep of Ironforge is an infuriating reminder of what Thermaplugg's treachery cost your people.
The salvaged mechano-tanks and battle suits prowling the yard demonstrate the dangerous resilience and destructive power of gnomish schematics when built without safety limiters.
